summary: CICS online Transaction Reports screen. The user chooses a report type -- Monthly, Yearly, or a Custom date range -- and the program validates the selection/dates and submits a batch job (writing a date-parameter and job to the internal reader / transient data queue) to run the transaction detail report (CBTRN03C). Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the reports screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; Enter process the report request. Return to CICS.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Determine which report was requested: Monthly (current month range), Yearly (current year range), or Custom (user start/end dates). For Custom, validate that both dates are present, valid calendar dates, and that start <= end. If valid, build the date-parameter record and submit the batch report job.
branches: EVALUATE report type: Monthly / Yearly / Custom

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: for a custom report the start and end dates must be valid and start must not be after end; Monthly/Yearly derive the range automatically.

paragraphs.name: VALIDATE-DATES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the start and end dates are real calendar dates (optionally via the date-validation utility CSUTLDTC).
paragraphs.notes: Date validation (may call the date utility).

paragraphs.name: SUBMIT-JOB
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the date-parameter record and submit the report batch job to the internal reader / transient-data queue so the batch report runs.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: the online screen triggers the batch report by submitting a job with the chosen date range.

paragraphs.name: SEND-RPT-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and send the reports map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-RPT-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the reports map from the terminal.
